subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
outcomes: Revise home technology words and phrasal verbs.
Give advice and make suggestions and offers.
Complete open cloze and multiple-choice cloze texts.

tf.s: We can heat dinner in a microwave.
'Why don't you watch a film to relax?' is a suggestion.
'Shall I…?' is used to make an offer.

tf.why: It means the same as 'You should…'
A kettle boils water; a fridge keeps food cold.

tf.s: 'How about to go out?' is correct.
tf.why: After 'How about' we use -ing: 'How about going out?'

tf.s: In a multiple-choice cloze, you choose the answer from options.
tf.why: You pick A, B, C or D.

tf.s: 'Ought to' is used to make an arrangement.
'Pronounce' means change a word into another language.
tf.why: That is 'translate'; 'pronounce' means say the sounds.

boxes.q: Complete: I'll heat your dinner in the ___.
A: I'm stressed about my exams. B: ___ watch a film to relax?
boxes.why: 'Why don't you + verb' makes a suggestion.

boxes.q: Complete: I always switch ___ the subtitles.
boxes.why: We switch on subtitles to see them.

boxes.q: Choose: Using the internet to ___ a foreign word is easy.
boxes.why: Translate means change into another language.

boxes.q: Choose: We're no longer ___ at remembering information.
Complete: You ___ to see a doctor.
Complete the offer: ___ I carry that for you?

boxes.why: Washing machine is a compound noun.

boxes.q: In an open cloze, how many words go in each gap?
boxes.why: Write one word in each gap.

hunt.q: Say a word with the right sounds

mcq.q: What do you write in each gap of an open cloze?
mcq.why: Only one word fits each gap.

mcq.q: Which is a home technology item?
mcq.why: A dishwasher is a machine at home.

mcq.q: Your friend is stressed about exams. What do you say?
o: Why don't you take a short break?
How about to study all night?
mcq.why: 'Why don't you…?' is a kind suggestion.

mcq.q: Your friend's bag is heavy. Offer to help.
o: Shall I carry it for you?

mcq.q: Complete: The TV is too loud. Can you ___ down?
mcq.why: The pronoun goes between turn and down.

mcq.q: Why is 'good' the right answer in 'we're no longer ___ at remembering information'?
o: 'Good at' is a correct adjective + preposition pair.

mcq.q: Why is 'translate' correct in 'Using the internet to ___ a foreign word is easy'?
o: It means change words into another language.
It means say a word aloud.
It means switch on a device.
mcq.why: Translation changes a word into your language.

mcq.q: What is a good way to evaluate your learning in Units 1-3?
o: Choose the most useful grammar point and three useful words
mcq.why: Thinking about what you learnt helps you remember it.
